blocks.text: Certified gas leak detector installation and gas detection system solutions for early leak detection, alarm response, and automatic shut-off across the UAE.

A gas leak doesn't announce itself until something's already wrong, which is exactly why gas leak detection can't be an afterthought in any building running LPG or natural gas. We install fixed gas leak detector systems and gas detection system setups that pick up a leak long before anyone in the building would notice it themselves, giving you the window to act instead of react.As a trusted gas leak detection company, we've installed and maintained gas detection systems across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, and the wider UAE for kitchens, plant rooms, and industrial process areas — each one calibrated to the specific gas and space it's covering, not fitted as a generic add-on.

blocks.alt: Technician inspecting gas leak detector and pressure gauge on industrial gas line

blocks.text: We assess the site first — where a leak is most likely to happen, what gas is in use, and what the room layout actually looks like — before deciding on gas leak detector placement and gas detection sensor type. Get the placement wrong and you've got a blind spot; we don't install until the layout's been walked and mapped properly.Once placement is confirmed, we wire detectors into a central control panel, integrate shut-off valves where the system calls for automatic isolation, and commission the whole gas leak detection setup under real conditions before handover. You get documentation showing exactly how the system was tested, not just told it works.

A gas detection sensor drifts out of calibration over time — it's not a set-and-forget device. We provide scheduled testing and calibration for gas leak detection systems as part of our AMC coverage. See our Gas Maintenance & AMC page for full details on service scheduling and coverage areas.

blocks.alt: Gas leak detection system diagram showing sensors, control panel, alarm, and shut-off valve

blocks.text: Fixed gas leak detectors continuously sample the air around them, checking gas concentration against a set threshold rather than waiting for a visible or smellable leak. When that threshold is crossed, the system triggers an alarm and — where configured — an automatic shut-off, cutting gas supply before it reaches a dangerous level. It's this constant monitoring that makes gas leak detection different from someone simply noticing a smell after the fact.Systems can also integrate into a building management system, so facilities staff get an alert on their own monitoring dashboard even if nobody's standing near the panel when it happens. That matters most in larger buildings where a single panel isn't going to be checked constantly — the alert needs to reach whoever's responsible, wherever they are, not just sound locally and hope someone's nearby.

We configure gas leak detection systems for LPG, natural gas, and other specialty gases depending on the application, matching sensor type to the specific gas and environment — a kitchen setup isn't calibrated the same way as an industrial process line, and treating them the same is how false alarms or missed detections happen.

A gas detection system installed in the UAE has to meet DOE regulations and civil defence requirements before it's considered operational, not as an afterthought once the equipment's already in. We handle that as part of the project — technical drawings, design submittals, and coordination with the relevant authority — so the system is approved alongside the installation, not chasing paperwork after the fact. Once commissioned, documentation stays on file so you're never scrambling if civil defence or DOE requests records during a routine or renewal inspection. For the full Istifa Certificate and civil defence approval process across all your fire and safety systems, see our Civil Defence Compliance page.
Everything you need to know about gas leak detection

items.a: Gas leak detection is the continuous monitoring of gas concentration in a building or facility, using fixed sensors that trigger an alarm — and often an automatic shut-off — before a leak reaches a dangerous level, rather than relying on someone noticing it by smell.

items.q: What triggers a gas detection alarm?
items.a: A gas detection sensor triggers an alarm when it reads gas concentration above its configured threshold — this can activate an audible alarm, a building management alert, and an automatic shut-off depending on how the system's set up.

items.q: How often does a gas detection sensor need calibration?
items.a: Sensors should be tested and calibrated on a scheduled basis since sensitivity drifts over time. This is covered under our Gas Maintenance & AMC service — see our Gas Maintenance & AMC page for scheduling and coverage details.

items.q: Can a gas leak detector shut off gas supply automatically?
items.a: Yes, gas detection systems can be integrated with automatic shut-off valves so gas flow stops the moment a leak's detected, rather than waiting on someone to respond manually.

items.q: Is gas detection required in commercial kitchens in the UAE?
items.a: It's commonly required under civil defence and DOE regulations for commercial kitchens and other high-risk gas areas — we can confirm the specific requirement for your property.

items.q: How much does a gas leak detection system cost?
items.a: Cost depends on the number of detection points, the gas type being monitored, and the size and layout of the space. Pricing is based on a site assessment rather than a flat rate — we aim to keep every installation competitively priced for its scope.

items.q: Are you a gas leak detection company across the UAE?
items.a: Yes — Firestone is a Civil Defence-approved gas leak detection company providing installation and gas monitor installation services across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, and the wider UAE.

items.q: Which areas do you cover for gas leak detection installation?
items.a: We provide gas leak detection system installation across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, and the wider UAE, covering commercial kitchens, industrial process areas, and plant rooms.

items.q: Do you offer industrial gas detection system installation?
items.a: Yes — we design and install industrial gas detection systems calibrated to the specific gas and process environment, alongside standard commercial and kitchen installations.
